title: The cranes are back
excerpt: All three portal cranes returned to the quay this week after five months of restoration in the yard.
html:
All three portal cranes returned to the quay this week after five months of restoration in the yard.

Each crane was lifted back onto its rails over three nights, one after another, starting with the one nearest the pier.

They are painted in their original oxide red. The new lights will come on for the first time at dusk once the electrical work is signed off.

title: Quayside reaches floor 14
excerpt: The frame of the tallest building is now two thirds of its final height.
html:
The frame of the tallest building is now two thirds of its final height.

The concrete frame is rising at one floor every nine days. Facade boards will follow the frame from the lower floors up.

Crane House, beside the cranes, is at floor 8 and the work on its courtyard side has started.

title: A water tram from day one
excerpt: The harbour authority confirmed a 15-minute service to Larch Quay Pier from the first day of occupation.
html:
The harbour authority confirmed a 15-minute service to Larch Quay Pier from the first day of occupation.

The tram will run every 15 minutes from 6:30 until midnight. The crossing to Old Town Pier takes nine minutes.

The pier is being finished now, with a covered waiting room and a ramp for prams and bicycles.

title: A show home in the Larch Store
excerpt: A furnished two-bedroom home is open for viewings on the ground floor of the old warehouse.
html:
A furnished two-bedroom home is open for viewings on the ground floor of the old warehouse.

The show home has the finish every home will have: a larch floor, a fitted kitchen and white walls.

It is open daily. Book a viewing and we will meet you at the pier.

title: A new roof for 1912
excerpt: The warehouse roof was rebuilt in larch and zinc, with the original iron trusses kept.
html:
The warehouse roof was rebuilt in larch and zinc, with the original iron trusses kept.

The trusses were cleaned and repainted on site, then fitted with a new larch deck and a zinc covering.

Inside, the Larch Store will hold a gym, a café, rooms to work in and a nursery for 60 children.

title: Yard and Terrace released
excerpt: 268 homes in the second phase are now in the catalogue.
html:
268 homes in the second phase are now in the catalogue.

Yard has 12 floors around the courtyard; Terrace steps down to nine floors with roof gardens on every step.

Keys to both buildings are planned for Q3 2028. Every home comes with a space for a bicycle and three- and four-bedroom homes include parking.

title: First concrete on the quay
excerpt: The foundation slab for Quayside was poured over two days and one night.
html:
The foundation slab for Quayside was poured over two days and one night.

Teams worked in shifts to keep the pour continuous. It is the largest single slab on the quay.

Crane House follows in June. Groundworks started in March with 214 piles for Quayside.
